    # Count the occurrences of each power of 2

    # Precompute the powers of 2 up to the maximum possible value

                min_coins = min(min_coins, 1 + power_count[b - power])
        
        return min_coins if min_coins != float('inf') else -1
    
    # Process each query
    results = []
    for b in queries:
        results.append(min_coins_needed(b))
